verdict.rationale: Greptile can be driven by natural language, but only through third-party coding agents connected to its MCP server. The docs show prompts like "List unaddressed Greptile comments for PR #5 in owner/repo", fetching comments, applying fixes and managing patterns from the editor, plus /check-pr and /greploop commands. Setup can be handed to a coding agent, and natural-language replies on reviews train its behavior. Core configuration (strictness, rules, triggers) still runs through greptile.json or the dashboard, and the product has no native chat or natural-language interface of its own. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface without an external agent, natural-language control of configuration and settings, independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP natural-language workflows.
